title: Share my ai screener
author: YoYo1675
selftext:
Hi, I'm not sure about Ai trading ,but Ai screener is not a bad choose.

This project base on anthropics/financial-services  
Because anthropics/financial-services required data sources are too expensive,So I build my own financial-services for individual investors  
you can find the project on github :`giordanoshai/tt-ai-screener`

* Data:
   * OHLCV,Fundamentals,News
* Features:
   * Long-term Screening
   * Swing Trade Screening
   * Position Review
   * Watchlist Analysis
   * MCP Server
